test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

He is in debt due to his __judicious__ tastes and habits.
solution:
The correct answer is **"extravagant"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is** 'extravagant.'**
 
• **Judicious:** having or showing reason and good judgment in making decisions. (निर्णय लेने में कारण और अच्छा निर्णय होना या दिखाना)
 
 
• ***Example: **We should make **judicious** use of the resources available to us.*
 
 
 
• Extravagant:</stron
